숲에서 노래를 들었다고 했죠?\n한 번 따라 불러 봤어요.\n그랬더니 숲:
Remember I heard a song in the forest?
I tried singing along, just once.
And the forest went quiet.
Right? I thought so too.
Songs are for taverns only.
The forest has a strange audience.
무슨 노래였는데?: What kind of song was it?
가사가 없었어요.\n그냥 음만… 내려가는 음.\n자꾸 아래로요. 땅 밑으:
It had no words.
Just notes... falling notes.
Down and down. Beneath the ground.
오늘은 제 노래만 불러요.\n올라가는 음으로요!:
Tonight I'll only sing my own songs.
With notes that go up!
지난밤 창이 떨렸습니다.\n엉겅퀴 창은 거짓을 모릅니다.\n어둠이 가까이:
Last night my spear trembled.
A thistle spear knows no falsehood.
The dark came close.
Stay inside the door at night.
As you command.
But I'll keep my spear
standing toward the door.
작은 몸으로 괜찮겠어?: Will you be all right, small as you are?
...I've heard "small"
a hundred times in the forest.
And all hundred times, I was the one left standing.
I'll keep watch tonight too.
Please, rest.
화살이 돌아온 날: The Day the Arrow Came Back
I shot an arrow into the forest
and it came back. To my feet.
...I didn't throw it, you know.
누가 던졌는지 봤어?: Did you see who threw it?
No. But there was moss
on the arrow tip.
Moss from underground.
네, 네. 안 써요.\n…근데 잘 날아갈 것 같긴 해요.\n농담이에요!:
Yes, yes. I won't.
...Though it looks like it'd fly well.
Just kidding! Half kidding.
Let's play target practice tomorrow.
Not the window spiders, though.
병든 가지를 찾아 숲에 갔소.\n한 나무는 가지가 전부 병들었더군.\n줄:
I went into the forest seeking sick branches.
One tree was sick in every branch.
To the trunk. To the roots.
I intend not to.
A tree with nothing left to cut
is no gardener's business.
치료할 방법은 없을까?: Is there no way to heal it?
…흙을 바꿔야 하오.\n이 숲 전체의 흙을.\n그건 가위로 할 일이 아니:
...The soil must be changed.
The soil of this whole forest.
That is not work for shears.
Tomorrow I'll mend the Lodge fence.
That, at least, is still alive.
The seeds are rolling away again.
Only toward the forest.
...Seeds don't do that.
Yes... I tied it.
But the whole pouch
keeps tilting, little by little.
...Together?
Together... maybe that'd be fine.
Only by day. Definitely by day.
I'll give you a seed.
Keep it by the window... it'll watch over you.
북쪽 샘이 검게 변했습니다.\n숲은 원인을 압니다.\n당신 집 아래의 돌:
The northern spring has turned black.
The forest knows the cause.
Things that covet the stone beneath your house.
숲도 그렇게 보고 있습니다.\n그래서 저를 보냈습니다.\n경고가 아니라…:
The forest sees it so as well.
That is why it sent me.
Not as a warning... as a greeting.
The forest does not move.
It only remembers.
What you have done.
Do not let the fire die.
The forest is watching. With good will.
씨앗 스물을 들고 왔는데\n열아홉이에요! 하나가!\n숲에서! 없어졌어요!:
I brought twenty seeds
and now there are nineteen! One!
Gone! In the forest!
어디서 잃어버린 것 같아?: Where do you think you lost it?
큰 돌 근처요! 검은 돌!\n거기서 배낭이 가벼워졌어요!\n…무거워졌나?:
Near the big stone! The black one!
My pack got lighter there!
...Or heavier? I don't know!
안 괜찮아요!\n그 씨앗이 거기서 자라면\n…뭐가 될지 몰라요!:
It's not fine!
If that seed grows there
...who knows what it'll become!
Let's go find it tomorrow! No, don't go!
...Huff, huff. Let's just sleep first.
I wrote down last night's dream.
It was a dream the stone was dreaming.
The stone... says it's lonely.
돌이 또 뭐라고 했어?: What else did the stone say?
...It called a name.
Not yours.
A much older one.
Don't write down any dreams tonight.
...Yawn. I won't.
But even if I don't dream,
the stone does.
...Yawn. Good night.
I hope the stone sleeps well too.
숲에서 눈이 둘… 셋… 넷!\n도망친 게 아니라\n전략적으로 빨리 왔어요:
In the forest, two eyes... three... four!
I didn't run away,
I strategically hurried here!
Good that you came. That's right.
그, 그렇죠?!\n형님… 아니 마녀님이 그러면\n그런 거죠! 하!:
R-right?!
Boss... I mean, Witch, if you say so,
then that's how it is! Ha!
Stay by my side at night.
…옆에요? 네!\n옆이면 안 도망쳐요.\n도망칠 데가 없으니까요!:
...By your side? Yes!
By your side I won't run.
There's nowhere to run to!
Next time I won't run.
...Not even strategically.
덫 일곱을 놨소.\n아침에 여덟이었지.\n여덟 번째엔 내 발자국이 걸려:
I set seven traps.
In the morning there were eight.
The eighth had my own footprints caught in it.
안 가져왔소. 셌지.\n내 덫 일곱만 들고 왔소.\n…근데 가방이 하나:
I didn't. I counted.
I brought only my seven traps.
...But my bag is one trap heavier.
An imitator would miscount.
...No, this one knows how to count.
That's what I like less.
Four windows, one door in the room.
I'll count again tonight.
셋째 톱이 숲에서 울었어.\n톱은 안 울어, 보통은.\n나무 안에 뭐가:
The third saw cried out in the forest.
Saws don't cry, usually.
There was something inside the tree.
안 봤어! 톱만 빼서 왔지.\n톱날에 뭔가 묻었는데\n톱밥이 아니야. 검:
Didn't look! Just pulled the saw out and left.
Something's smeared on the blade,
and it's not sawdust. It's black.
Don't use that saw for a while.
…알았어. 첫째, 둘째로 할게.\n근데 셋째가 제일 잘 들어.\n…헤헤,:
...Fine. I'll use the first and second.
But the third cuts best.
...Heh, joking. I won't.
Tomorrow, only trees near the Lodge.
Where the saws don't cry.
숲에서 주운 반짝이요.\n눈이었어요. 근데요,\n주머니 안에서 깜빡였어요:
A shiny thing I picked up in the forest.
It was an eye. And then,
it blinked inside my pocket.
...Yes. I gave it back to the forest.
But my pocket is still
warm.
내게 보여 줄 수 있어?: Can you show it to me?
It's gone now!
I turned around and it was gone.
I never even opened the pocket.
새 주머니엔 좋은 것만요.\n이 집 단추 같은 거요. 안 가져가요!:
Only good things in my new pocket.
Like this house's buttons. I won't take them!
숲에서 물건을 잃었는데\n손해 본 느낌이 아니에요.\n뭔가를 받은 느낌이:
I lost some things in the forest,
but it doesn't feel like a loss.
It feels like I received something. What could it be?
단추 셋, 끈 하나, 그리고…\n기억 하나? 작은 거요.\n어린 시절 어:
Three buttons, a string, and...
a memory? A small one.
From somewhere in my childhood.
Don't make deals in the forest anymore.
I won't. A deal whose price
even a merchant can't see
is a bad deal.
Full price for the stay. No haggling.
...Just for today.
The door deep in the forest.
I said I went in ten times, right?
Actually it was once. I never got out.
…모르겠어요. 눈 떠 보니\n굴뚝 연기가 보였어요.\n지도에 문이 안 그:
...I don't know. I opened my eyes
and saw chimney smoke.
The door won't show up on my map.
I won't! ...I do want to.
I'm an explorer, after all.
I won't. Really.
This house shows up on my map.
Big. The biggest of all.
감정 좀 해 주실래요?: Would you appraise something for me?
모르는 얼굴의 동전: The Coin With an Unknown Face
숲에서 주운 동전이요.\n새겨진 얼굴을 모르겠어요.\n고블린도 인간도 아:
A coin I found in the forest.
I don't recognize the face on it.
Not a goblin, not a human.
얼굴이 어떻게 생겼는데?: What does the face look like?
...It's smiling.
But every time I look,
it smiles a little more.
I have no plans to.
If I can't price it,
I don't sell it. That's my rule.
Do sell your lanterns to me.
I pay generously.
숲 냄새가 바뀌었다.\n쇠, 썩은 잎, 그리고\n…무리의 냄새. 내 무리:
The forest smell has changed.
Iron, rotten leaves, and
...the scent of a pack. Not my pack.
그게 뭔지 알아?: Do you know what it is?
안다. 늑대가 아니다.\n늑대처럼 움직일 뿐.\n…오늘 밤은 문 앞에 눕:
I do. It is not a wolf.
It only moves like one.
...Tonight I will lie before the door.
...The pack left me.
In this house,
we don't speak of that.
Twelve eyes in the forest.
Eight were beasts.
Four did not blink.
The northern spring.
Above the water.
...Or below it.
Yes.
I see better at night.
If the four come, I'll tell you.
You can put the fire out.
I can see.
곰은 겨울에 자야 해.\n근데 이 숲에선 잠이 안 와.\n땅 밑에서 뭐가:
Bears must sleep in winter.
But I can't sleep in this forest.
Something is stirring beneath the ground.
...Like snoring.
Very loud and slow.
Something bigger than a bear is sleeping.
Mmm... thanks.
But I'll sleep only half.
One eye on the door.
I'll leave half a jar of honey.
...Only half. Winter is long.
A sound follows me in the forest.
When I turn around, nothing's there.
But my basket gets lighter.
뭘 가져간 것 같아?: What do you think it took?
약초는 그대로예요.\n…제 발자국이 없어졌어요.\n돌아보면 길이 깨끗해요:
The herbs are all still here.
...My footprints are gone.
When I look back, the path is clean.
Yes! Only by day!
I'll gather triple before sundown.
...And I won't look back.
A corner of the room is nice.
A hole-like spot... feels safe.
꼬리로 길을 외운다고 했죠?\n오늘은 꼬리가 틀렸어요.\n길이 저를 다른:
I told you I remember roads with my tail, right?
Today my tail was wrong.
The road took me somewhere else.
큰 돌이요. 검은 돌.\n거기서 꼬리가 섰어요.\n여우 꼬리는 안 서는데:
The big stone. The black one.
My tail stood up there.
A fox's tail doesn't do that.
From now on, just look for the chimney and come.
That's the plan.
The road can't change a chimney.
...Can it? No, surely not.
No shortcuts for a while.
Even if it takes half a day longer.
Something pulled my bag in the forest.
I didn't let go.
...The hand was cold.
Mine.
...And one more.
Not mine. I don't open it.
You can put it down here.
...I won't.
If I let go, they take it.
Even here.
밤의 숲에서 들었어요.\n누군가 돌을 부르고 있어요.\n이름으로요. 아주:
I heard it in the night forest.
Someone is calling the stone.
By name. A very old name.
Not just one.
Many, in the same voice.
...An owl is never wrong.
안 가요. 올빼미는\n부르는 쪽으로 안 날아요.\n부르는 것을 보러 가죠:
I won't. An owl
doesn't fly toward the calling.
It goes to watch whatever calls.
I'll sleep when the sun rises.
Thanks for the window light.
A debt for borrowing a roof is paid with the sword.
But last night there was no need to draw it.
The debt remains.
There's no debt. You're a guest.
...Our law is different.
Then I will repay it next night.
A debt does not vanish.
Very well. I stand before the door.
A door where I stand
has never been opened.
Sleep well, mistress.
The indebted stay awake.
I left half a deer behind.
Something took it.
Left only the bones. Clean.
Beasts don't stack bones.
They were stacked. Like a tower.
...Out of my own game.
Don't go deep for a while.
Hmph, saying that to a hunter.
...Fine. Only near the Lodge.
I'll make do with rabbit.
Dinner's on me tonight.
Three rabbits. Get the pot out.
나무를 베기 전엔 말해.\n미안하다, 고맙다.\n이 숲 나무는 대답을 안:
Before felling a tree, I speak to it.
Sorry, and thank you.
The trees in this forest never answer. Except one.
..."Not yet."
So I didn't cut it.
Haha... not funny, is it.
안 가! 도끼도 안 들어.\n근데 그루터기에 꽃은 두고 왔어.\n예의니까:
I won't! Won't even carry my axe.
But I left a flower on the stump.
It's only polite.
내일은 말 없는 나무만 벨게.\n하하! 문 조심할게!:
Tomorrow I'll only fell the silent trees.
Haha! I'll watch the door!
숲의 뿌리가 검게 물들어요.\n제 약으론 모자라요.\n스승은 '재가 깨끗:
The forest's roots are turning black.
My medicine isn't enough.
My teacher said to find "a house with clean ashes."
You can take this house's ashes.
...Thank you.
I'll use them in the rite.
I can save one root.
...Deep in the forest.
She went to save the roots.
She hasn't come back. Not yet.
Tonight I'll sleep by the hearth.
So the ashes don't go cold.
I cast the bones.
Tonight the door will shake three times.
The fourth is a knock. Do not open it.
The bones never say "who."
They only say "when."
...It will be a voice you know.
뼈가 틀린 적은 없어?: Have the bones ever been wrong?
Yes. When I read them wrong.
Today I read them well.
...That is why I came.
Sleep. I'll watch the bones.
Through the fourth.
숲의 돌 앞에서 절을 했소.\n조상에게 하듯이.\n그런데 그건 조상이 아:
I bowed before the stone in the forest.
As one does to an ancestor.
But it was not an ancestor.
It said nothing.
It simply accepted the bow.
...It knew how to accept one.
조상의 길은 끝나지 않소.\n이 집이 길에 든 것처럼\n그 돌도 길에 들:
The ancestors' road never ends.
Just as this house joined the road,
that stone has simply joined it too.
I'll sleep by the fire.
They say the ancestors did too.
I boiled a full pot,
and by morning it was empty.
And we hadn't eaten any yet.
누가 먹은 것 같아?: Who do you think ate it?
숲의 것들이겠죠.\n…배가 고팠나 봐요.\n미워할 수가 없네요. 먹는 건:
Creatures of the forest, I suppose.
...They must have been hungry.
I can't hate them for it. Eating, that is.
그래야죠. 근데요,\n한 그릇은 문 밖에 둘래요.\n…그래야 솥을 안 가:
I will. But,
I'll leave one bowl outside the door.
...That way they won't take the pot.
Let's boil it again! Double!
Everyone eats together. Inside.
...Mistress. I have a favor to ask.
…배가 고프다.\n사흘을 굶었다. 산장 음식으론 안 된다.\n목장의 검은:
...I am hungry.
Three days without food. Lodge fare won't do.
The pasture's black sheep... give me just one.
…은혜는 잊지 않는다.\n이걸 받아라. 늑대의 피다.\n달이 뜨는 밤에:
...I won't forget this kindness.
Take this. Wolf's blood.
Use it on a moonlit night... and you will know.
...There is no black sheep.
Very well. I am grateful for your word alone.
...I will ask again another time.
I can't give you a sheep.
...I see.
They are the Lodge keeper's sheep. Understood.
...I will ask again another time.
...Sleep well.
I will be awake tonight.
술 냄새를 따라온 손님: The Guest Who Followed the Smell of Drink
딸꾹! 이 집에서 술 냄새가 솔솔 나더라고.\r: Hic! I caught a whiff of drink drifting from this house.
Sure, have a drink before you go.
어라… 내 술병이 다 어디 갔지?\r: Huh... where did all my bottles go?
에이~ 딱 한 잔만 하려고 했는데.\r: Aw~ I was only going to have one.
아아, 이 집 난롯불 좋다.\r: Ahh, this house has a lovely hearth fire.
